meta.name: convex-performance-audit
meta.description: Audits Convex performance for reads, subscriptions, write contention, and function limits. Use for slow features, insights findings, OCC conflicts, or read amplification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计 Convex 性能瓶颈并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 Convex 应用出现性能问题需要定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Audit Convex performance and pinpoint optimization opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Convex app has performance issues and you need to find root causes

howto.what: Claude 会分析 Convex 应用的性能问题，包括读取、订阅、写入冲突和函数限制。它会收集信号、定位问题类别、追踪读写路径，并应用参考文件中的修复方案。
howto.when: 当 Convex 页面或功能感觉慢或昂贵，或 `npx convex insights --details` 报告高字节读取、文档读取或 OCC 冲突时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计 Convex 应用的读取性能。
say.note: Claude 会收集信号并分析热路径。

say.text: 分析 OCC 冲突错误并给出修复建议。
say.note: Claude 会参考 OCC 冲突参考文件。

howto.what_en: Claude audits Convex performance for reads, subscriptions, write contention, and function limits. It gathers signals, identifies problem classes, traces read/write paths, and applies fixes from reference files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a Convex page or feature feels slow or expensive, or when `npx convex insights --details` reports high bytes read, documents read, or OCC conflicts.

say_en.text: Audit the read performance of my Convex app.
say_en.note: Claude will gather signals and analyze hot paths.

say_en.text: Analyze OCC conflict errors and suggest fixes.
say_en.note: Claude will reference the OCC conflicts file.
